subject: science

concepts.title: Fabric Composition
concepts.definition: Fabrics are materials formed by the systematic arrangement of yarns, which are themselves composed of twisted thin strands known as fibres.
concepts.key_idea: Fibres form yarns, and yarns form fabrics.
question_patterns: what are fabrics made of
describe the relationship between fibre yarn and fabric
how is a fabric structured
identify the components of a piece of cloth
explain the hierarchy of fabric construction

solution_steps.explain: fibres are the basic units that combine to form yarns, which are then woven or knitted into fabrics.

concepts.title: Fibre Classification
concepts.definition: Fibres are categorized based on their origin: natural fibres come from biological sources like plants or animals, while synthetic fibres are produced from chemical substances.
concepts.key_idea: Fibres are either naturally sourced or chemically manufactured.
question_patterns: classify the given fibres as natural or synthetic
what is the difference between natural and man-made fibres
list examples of synthetic fibres
how do we distinguish between plant and animal fibres
categorize wool and polyester correctly

solution_steps.explain: if the fibre originates from a plant or animal, it is natural; otherwise, it is synthetic.

concepts.title: Spinning Efficiency
concepts.definition: Spinning is the mechanical or manual process of drawing out and twisting fibres to create a continuous yarn.
concepts.key_idea: Twisting fibres together creates strength and length in yarn.
question_patterns: calculate the potential yarn length from a mass of fibres
how much yarn is produced if the twist factor is given
determine the output of the spinning process
find the total yarn length based on fibre quantity
compute the yarn yield given the twist efficiency

solution_steps.explain: the total length of the yarn depends on the amount of raw fibre and the efficiency of the twisting process.

concepts.title: Weaving Area Calculation
concepts.definition: Weaving is the process of interlacing two distinct sets of yarns at right angles to produce a fabric sheet.
concepts.key_idea: Weaving creates a two-dimensional surface from one-dimensional yarns.
question_patterns: calculate the area of the woven fabric
find the total surface area of a cloth piece
what is the area of a fabric with given dimensions
determine the size of the fabric sheet
compute the area of the woven material

solution_steps.explain: the area of a rectangular fabric is the product of its length and width.

worked_examples.question_pattern: if you have {fibres_twisted} units of fibre and a twist factor of {twist_factor} find the yarn length

solution_template.explain: multiply the fibre amount by the twist factor.

worked_examples.question_pattern: calculate the area of a fabric piece with length {length} cm and width {width} cm
